title: Deliver reliable letter-learning lessons from the reality-check bridge
description:
User-requested comprehensive TODO and implementation of the October13 reality check.
Creation gate: consumer is this user and the implementing agent; gate is completing every identified fix without losing subtasks; observed defects include lost profile scores, broken rounds and hanging tracing; retire active tracking when all acceptance criteria pass (retain completed history, no deletion).
Integrity exception not needed. Opportunity cost: resampler/profile fixes have higher value than prolonged tracker work; creation/polishing is bounded to one task graph, then code.
Checklist: B00–B16 below cover all32 vision goals. No capability credit for planning. Preserve all modes, vocabularies, optional neural path, themes, celebrations, profiles and parent tools. Physical handwriting/audio/device gates stay explicitly open unless tested.
notes: Nine scoped implementation tasks closed with source-bound evidence. Eight original qualification/dependency tasks remain open; overall project acceptance is incomplete. Latest code and harness are pushed to main and compatibility mirror.

Bounded audit: this authorized October 13 task, original bf06cba and current staged/working diffs. Purpose from README: a single-file game helping young children learn the alphabet through sound, visuals and drawing.

Real-work inventory: git log/reflog, full owned diff and live br list were inspected. Before landing, there are zero author commits and zero closed beads. The peer's f5da7dc only preserved the initial tracker and earns no app credit. The 11 owned pending paths classify as USER 3 (HTML, README, changelog), ENABLER 7 (package/lock, tests, workflow, ignore), PROCESS 1 (Beads), UNKNOWN 0. This is a diagnostic, not a quota. Strongest two-minute demo: create the first player, answer correctly, reload and retain the same displayed/profile score. The process list does not itself fix those behaviors; it meets the user's explicit tracking request. The tests have already exposed real bugs and failed fixtures, not speculative infrastructure. Statuses in this original matrix are historical observations, not current implementation claims. B00–B16 map respectively to llg-ova.1–llg-ova.17. These full goals and original bridge scope are retained here so execution does not require the scratch report. Later implementation and verification comments describe the candidate; real quality criteria are unchanged.

**Vision checklist**

**Prioritized bridge plan**

These are self-contained task outlines with dependencies and acceptance criteria. Priority 0 means a critical correctness/data blocker; priority 1 means necessary for the documented experience; priority 2 means follow-up completeness or documentation. Complexity is relative (S/M/L), not a delivery-time estimate. Every task includes its own verification; B00 supplies the harness and B16 supplies final integrated proof.

| Task | Priority / size | Change and acceptance criteria | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| B00: Retain meaningful browser regression evidence | P1 / M | Add a real test command and CI checks for normal startup, all modes, mode/profile changes, saved-state reload, short screens, and unavailable optional assets. Fail on page errors; retain console logs, screenshots, trace files, seed/configuration, source revision, and explicit expected/actual results. Add the reproduced bugs as failing regression cases alongside scoped fixes. | None |
| B01: Correct and bound tracing geometry | P0 / M | Rewrite the arc-length resampler so it consumes segment distance, never extrapolates, produces the requested finite point count for nondegenerate paths, and terminates on empty, singleton, repeated-point, and regularly spaced inputs. Avoid joining separated strokes with invented travel segments when measuring shape. Test 48-point line, 0→100 line, translation/scale invariance, interpolation-density invariance, and multiple strokes. | B00 |
| B02: Give each lesson context one lifecycle | P1 / M | Introduce one generation/context identity containing mode, question, and player. Cancel registered timeouts, intervals, animation timelines, speech continuations, and pending mic work on context changes. Require callbacks to validate identity before changing state/DOM. Reset locks explicitly; dispose detached Word Builder floating timelines. Native rapid transitions from success/wrong/timeout/phonics/minigames must never restore another mode's UI. | B00 |
| B03: Complete rounds and integrate breaks in every relevant mode | P1 / M | Route completion after outcome processing/phonics, before starting a new prompt. Recommended contract: 15 resolved target prompts (correct or timed out); retries remain attempts and count toward accuracy, without losing the current retry behavior. Track prompt count separately from attempts/correct count. Complete exactly once, show accurate summaries/problem letters, persist completed rounds, and continue in the current mode. Offer mini-games once at a defined break boundary and resume the originating mode. Deterministically verify break/no-break branches, 15th answer, final timeout, final phonics skip, perfect round, and repeated callback protection. | B02 |
| B04: Make player state authoritative and durable | P0 / M | Keep one player-owned progress representation and render/save from it. Show Add Player on first run; provide safe keyboard-accessible selection. Commit active progress to both display and storage after outcomes and at autosave/unload boundaries. Isolate session streaks, Word Builder difficulty, response times, counters, and pending callbacks between players. Alice/Bob tests must demonstrate immediate displayed/saved agreement, reload durability, correct owner attribution during pending callbacks, and per-player play time. Render names as text. | B02 |
| B05: Unify outcome/progress accounting | P1 / M | Route Identify, Word Builder, tracing, timeouts, and echo rewards through an explicit outcome ledger with separate mode/skill domains. Preserve mode-specific +20/−5 WB scoring and the documented Identify cap. A correctly copied/spelled word must not automatically count as proof of auditory letter recognition or tracing mastery. Define whether tracing rejections update performance or remain practice-only, then label dashboard data accordingly. Make streak resets, lifetime totals, mastery, score/time/speed/round badges, response-time samples, and daily activity use the ledger. Initialize first-day streak on actual play; use calendar-date arithmetic across DST. Validate every badge, per-player play time, round summary scope, and zero-data cases. | B03, B04 |
| B06: Hydrate and apply settings consistently | P1 / M | Use one validated settings representation and one apply routine at startup and after changes. Restore timer/case/sound/phonics/theme/voice/Word Builder/accessibility values and synchronize selected buttons. Implement setWordBuilderMode and a safe response when disabling the active mode. Timer off must stop the active countdown; Focus Mode must always suppress timers; its previous timer preference must restore correctly. Reduce Motion must control CSS, GSAP, RAF, and overlay paths on reload and during play. Test current question, reload, and saved milestone load. | B04, B05 |
| B07: Repair canvas lifecycle and exact-case formation guides | P1 / M | Reapply pen attributes after backing-store changes. Preserve and scale strokes on viewport changes or deliberately clear both pixels and recognition points together. Use device pixel ratio consistently. Provide correct upper/lower-case formation paths for all 52 targets, with stroke order and clear static fallback labels. Repeated guide show/hide must not accumulate numbers. Test 8px/round/purple drawing, resized visual/recognition agreement, i/j dots, upper B, idle hints, and pointer/touch cancellation. | B01, B02 |
| B08: Establish tracing quality and latency acceptance | P1 / L | After geometry repair, require all canonical shape fixtures to pass consistently across point densities; evaluate reversals, scale changes, noisy correct traces, wrong letters, loops, crosses, dots/crossbars, and scribbles. Assemble a permission-appropriate real handwriting corpus with held-out examples, and set explicit per-letter acceptance/error targets based on observed child usability before tuning. Compare classical-only and deep-enabled results and report the tradeoff. Bound synchronous work; measure on representative phones before adopting latency targets. Do not treat a successful model load as recognition-quality proof. | B01, B07 |
| B09: Stop microphone and playback resources reliably | P1 / S–M | Make streams/recorders/playback context-owned. Stop tracks and close AudioContexts in cleanup/finally paths regardless of removed DOM nodes or delayed permission results. Cancel recording/echo on mode/player changes, settings disable, and lesson teardown. Capture the recording's letter identity for later comparison. Test allow/deny/delayed permission, start→switch, stop with removed controls, playback completion/failure, and zero live tracks after exit. Include one real-device mic/playback acceptance run. | B02 |
| B10: Complete keyboard, dialog, audio-alternative, and motion behavior | P1 / M | Use native buttons for cards, avatars, and profiles; provide basket keyboard controls. Give dialogs names/roles, inert background or equivalent exclusion, one active focus trap, and reliable close/focus return for Escape/backdrop/buttons. Supply visible/assistive target prompts when audio is off or unavailable. Apply accessibility settings to every mode and test both OS and in-app reduced motion. Verify keyboard-only completion, screen-reader prompts, modal focus order, contrast, zoom, and every exit path. | B06, B07, B09 |
| B11: Make all core controls reachable on short screens | P1 / M | Remove the incompatible canvas minimum/overflow combination. Fit controls where possible and allow a deliberate scroll path where needed, retaining usable touch targets and drawing gestures. Test 320×568, 390×844, 844×390, larger tablets/desktop, browser-chrome changes, zoom, and native touch scrolling. Assertions must check hit testing/reachability, not only screenshot dimensions. | B07, B10 |
| B12: Make adaptation and dashboards evidence-based | P2 / M | Preserve weighted selection for small due pools; test due/recency/error-bias interplay using controlled sampling. Use current authoritative player data for dashboard cards/heatmaps. Require sufficient response samples before “Quick Recognition”; show “no data yet” when appropriate. Distinguish current-player recommendations from aggregated heatmaps. Validate synthetic histories, no-data, conflicting player histories, and all-mode outcomes. Correct draw analytics' absent-deep representation/reset behavior while touching its schema. | B04, B05, B08 |
| B13: Keep optional dependencies off the core startup path | P2 / S–M | Load optional recognition assets when tracing needs them; keep the classical path immediately usable and visibly responsive during warmup/failure. Preserve GSAP/RAF behavior and disclosed external-service behavior. Test slow, blocked, and unavailable CDNs/model assets with real request failures; compare startup and draw latency before/after on stated hardware/network conditions. Avoid claiming measured production performance from this audit's two cold runs. | B08, B10 |
| B14: Validate local data and degrade gracefully | P1 / M | Guard storage reads/writes centrally, validate/normalize game/profile/analytics shapes, and provide playable in-memory behavior when storage is unavailable. Handle null/arrays/malformed JSON/missing nested fields/old field types/quota errors. Make reset actions clear the promised statistics consistently, including session timers and draw analytics if advertised. Ordinary saves and resets must survive reload; persistence failures must be understandable to parents. | B04, B05, B06 |
| B15: Align documentation with proven behavior | P2 / S | Replace precise-correspondence assertions with verified contracts. Describe actual word pools and lengths, guide coverage, score/question semantics, adaptive limitations, audio requirements, microphone behavior, storage scope, analytics presence, and optional deep-quality limits. Preserve existing vocabulary/features; correct labels rather than silently removing words such as cheese. Update changelog's current-revision/statistics wording. Record remaining known limitations explicitly. Celebration-theme UI is optional because README already disclaims it; Speed Demon is a known wired-progress follow-up. | B03–B14 |
| B16: Prove the complete family/classroom session | P1 / M | Run all retained tests and a human acceptance session: fresh load, first profile, 15-question lessons in supported modes, wrong/retry/timeout, phonics/echo/skip, both mini-games, achievements, dashboard, setting changes, two players, reload, short-screen touch, and unavailable optional services. Qualify Chrome/Firefox/Safari and a physical phone's speech/mic behavior. Bind evidence to the candidate revision. After deployment, verify published HTML matches that tested revision. No completion claim while any required core/accessibility/data gate remains red. | B00–B15 |

**Execution order and completion boundary**

Start with retained reproductions, then fix the tracing resampler and shared context lifecycle. Profile ownership and round routing follow; they can be designed alongside each other but should land with their regression proofs. Unify the progress ledger, hydrate settings, and repair canvas/formation guidance. Complete microphone cleanup, accessibility and short-screen reachability. Then qualify recognition, adaptation/dashboard truth, storage degradation, and optional loading. Update docs from the final proven behavior and run B16.

The dependency graph is acyclic: B00 → {B01,B02}; B02 → {B03,B04,B09}; {B03,B04} → B05 → B06; {B01,B02} → B07 → B08; {B06,B07,B09} → B10 → B11; {B04,B05,B08} → B12; {B08,B10} → B13; {B04,B05,B06} → B14; B03…B14 → B15; all → B16.

I refined this plan through three expansion passes and five review passes. Expansion widened the initial feature check into state/resource ownership, geometric invariants plus measured recognition behavior, and shipped/mobile/accessibility proof. The refinement passes checked (1) every README promise, (2) dependency and state ownership, (3) discriminating tests and logging, (4) first-run/silent/short-screen usability and privacy behavior, and (5) feature preservation, documentation accuracy, and completion gates. The final review found no additional uncovered README goal. This is plan convergence, not a claim that implementation or product qualification is complete.
